evidence.evidence_method: Read GLB v2 JSON chunk, traverse the declared active scene, count indexed accessor or POSITION count / 3 for triangles and n-2 for strips/fans, with node and EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing multiplicity. No inactive collider scene, frustum assumptions or material-pass multiplier in triangles. Unique mesh total separately includes each mesh once, including inactive meshes. Bytes from actual files. Material names/count refer to distinct materials on active draws. Runtime file metrics are per single instantiated scene, not captures.

conventions.position: Metres [x,y,z], bottom-centre at finished installation; datum is slot-centre at Y=0. Normalise source pivots/front axes at import. yaw_deg is right-handed about +Y. Facing +Z is toward concourse. Envelope [width,height,depth] before yaw. A fitted assembly includes supports and adapters required to attain the indicated top socket; preserve physical product proportions.
conventions.status: Budgets are inclusive proposed maxima for a complete tier representation of shop-specific content; textures are decimal MB, uncompressed RGBA8 with complete mips. Common architecture, sign system and existing public areas have a separate unchanged baseline.
conventions.reuse: Other than the listed NEW slugs, geometry derives from library assets or documented room components. A material swap or consolidation of meshes does not force new art direction. Each allocated repeat is charged per visible instance.

shared_far_representation.allocation: One 4-by-5 atlas of neutral distant finishes/cleared marks with gutters. Opaque+emissive far batches across the visible wings. Never draw far and full representations of the same slot at once.

library_scan_scope: Physical .glb files in models/ and public/, independent of version tracking. Seeded discovery by seven lists, then searched all 545 metadata sidecars. Other roots in scan.glb_files are context only. No publication state inferred from local presence.

entrance_screenshots.pose: Use default third-person with identical camera setting and HUD, face inward, stand 0.75 m outside the threshold with leaves fully open. One optional interior comparison per store at browse position.
entrance_screenshots.blind_check: Mask shop and HUD names; identify the store using its signature and materials. Require 17 correct and a visible floor zone for every slot.
entrance_screenshots.targets: At the entrance the anchor should subtend at least 120 CSS px on its longest visible axis, distinct from the avatar. S01 official front must be legible on approach. Measure UI text contrast >=4.5:1.

how_to_verify.acceptance: Three cold completed foreground Low runs; zero presented frame intervals >=50 ms including first RAF. Extend the existing 3-original route with live walking at all 14 other storefronts and lift/upper deck. Archive contiguous windows, sample count, p95, p99, max, slow events, actual draw calls and triangles, device, tier and viewport. Repeat target-phone route on hardware.
